excerpt: International humanitarian law regulates armed conflict after war has begun. This article explains the Geneva Conventions, Additional Protocols, Common Article 3, conflict classification, protected persons, prisoners of war, occupation, humanitarian relief, targeting, customary IHL, war crimes, and the relationship between IHL, human rights law, and the UN Charter framework.
